title: Renderer mods are mandatory, and the picker opens upward
description: Whichever renderer you pick on the Play screen, its mod is now a required part of the pack: Sodium when the renderer is Sodium, VulkanMod when it is Vulkan, always resolved to the newest build that fits the version. The renderer menu also opens above its button now, the only four mods that are on by default are BestClient, Sodium, Fabric API and Lithium - and they are on, not off. The resource pack and shader switch is gone from Settings, and the Memory text reads again.
changes: Sodium is mandatory while the renderer is Sodium, VulkanMod while it is Vulkan - locked in the pack, resolved to the latest build at install time
The Sodium/Vulkan menu on the Play screen opens above its button instead of below
By default the client installs BestClient, Sodium, Fabric API and Lithium and nothing else - all four enabled
Removed the "Resource packs and shader" switch from Settings; the launcher no longer offers any look to install
Fixed the broken text in the Memory section - the garbled characters are proper again

title: Pick your renderer, and a client that starts empty
description: The renderer is now a choice on the Play screen - Sodium, Vulkan or plain OpenGL - and each one installs the mods that belong to it. A fresh client arrives with four mods and no resource pack, because what you add should be what you asked for.
changes: Renderer picker beside the version: Sodium, Vulkan (VulkanMod) or Minecraft’s own OpenGL. Each installs its own set, and Vulkan is only offered where it has a build
The client now starts with Fabric API, Sodium, Lithium and BestClient, and nothing else - everything else is one switch away on the Mods screen
Resource packs and the shader are off by default and have their own switch in Settings
Fabric API can no longer be turned off: the BestClient mod depends on it
In-game: "Hurt camera" is now "No hurt cam" and works the way the rest of the menu does - switching it on removes the tilt. It read backwards before, so turning it on appeared to do nothing
In-game: the brightness slider is gone; fullbright stays
Partner servers: names, player counts and MOTDs are all in Minecraft’s own alphabet
New artwork for 26.2, and the version cards ease into their zoom instead of snapping to it

title: The launcher checks the mods against each other before the game does
description: Two mods that refuse to load together used to reach you as "exited with code 1". The launcher now reads what every jar demands of the others, settles the disagreement by holding one mod a build back, and says plainly what happened when it cannot.
changes: Every installed jar is read before launch and checked against the others, including the libraries bundled inside them and inside Fabric Loader itself
A mod that cannot load beside another is stepped back through its own older builds until one fits - Sodium Extra now yields to the Sodium build Nvidium needs, instead of stopping the game
When nothing fits, the Play screen names both mods and both versions instead of leaving you a number
A crash now shows what the game actually said, not only its exit code
The launcher log is written straight to disk, so its last lines survive a crash
Sound Culling is offered only on 26.1.2 and 26.2, the versions it is published for
Update all: white text

title: The launcher checks the mods against each other before the game does
description: Two mods that refuse to load together used to reach you as "exited with code 1". The launcher now reads what every jar demands of the others, settles the disagreement by holding one mod a build back, and says plainly what happened when it cannot.
changes: Every installed jar is read before launch and checked against the others, including the libraries bundled inside them and inside Fabric Loader itself
A mod that cannot load beside another is stepped back through its own older builds until one fits - Sodium Extra now yields to the Sodium build Nvidium needs, instead of stopping the game
When nothing fits, the Play screen names both mods and both versions instead of leaving you a number
A crash now shows what the game actually said, not only its exit code
The launcher log is written straight to disk, so its last lines survive a crash
Sound Culling is offered only on 26.1.2 and 26.2, the versions it is published for
Update all: white text

title: The in-game menu is real, and six mods for a smoother game
description: Right Shift now opens the client menu it was always meant to open - its own look, its own typeface, thirteen modules - and fullbright finally works. Six mods join the pack, including one that stops fullscreen from throwing Discord out of fullscreen.
changes: The BestClient mod is built and shipped for the first time: Right Shift opens a menu with its own artwork, typeface and thirteen modules
Fullbright works - it was never actually wired up before
New modules: FPS, CPS, coordinates, direction, speed, ping, clock, playtime, memory and a WASD keystroke overlay
Borderless Fullscreen: the game no longer takes over the display, so Discord and anything else stay where they were
Sodium Extra, AsyncParticles, Smart Particles, Better Block Entities and Sound Culling join the pack
Mods screen: Update all replaces the active-mod counter
Settings: the Discord switch is labelled Discord RPC, and the startup flags box only asks for your own additions

title: Locked startup flags and a newer Java
description: The tuned startup flags can no longer be rewritten - you add to them instead - and every version now runs on the current long-term Java release.
changes: Startup flags: the tuned set is fixed and shown in full; your own flags go in their own box and run after it, so anything you add still wins
Every version runs on Java 25 now, never below what the game itself asks for
"Reset PvP defaults" is now "Reset defaults"
Update all matches the other buttons: white text on the standard grey

title: Update every mod at once
description: One button on the Mods screen moves everything to its newest build, and works out which ones cannot go together before it touches anything.
changes: New Update all button on the Mods screen
Before anything is installed, each new build's own compatibility rules are read: a build that will not work alongside another mod you have is left where it is, and named
Both directions are checked - a new build that rejects an installed mod, and an installed mod that rejects the new build
The client refuses to start if its own mod is missing or fails its hash check, instead of launching without it

title: The version sits in its own panel
description: The version and renderer above Launch now sit together in a small frosted panel, with the edit mark lined up against the version.
changes: The version and OpenGL are in their own rounded panel above the Launch button
The edit mark is centred against the version instead of sitting on its baseline

title: A bigger line above Launch
description: The version and renderer above the Launch button are larger, and the edit mark is a quiet grey that turns white under the cursor.
changes: The version and OpenGL above Launch are noticeably larger
The edit mark is grey at rest and white when you hover it
It no longer grows under the cursor - a target that moves is harder to hit

title: The version leads the line
description: Above Launch the version now comes first, with the edit mark against it, and the renderer sits behind it.
changes: The version and the label swapped places: the version leads, OpenGL follows
Only the version is clickable now - the renderer beside it is a fact, not a button
The edit mark is white and larger, and grows under the cursor

title: A roomier version picker
description: The version picker is much larger, and picking one leaves it open so you can look at the others.
changes: The picker fills far more of the window, with bigger artwork and a bigger version number on each
Choosing a version no longer closes the picker - the card lights up and you stay where you are
The "In use" tag is gone; the lit card is the answer

title: Pick a Minecraft version
description: Fight and Survival are gone. There is one mod pack - the PvP one - and you choose which Minecraft to run it on: 26.2, 26.1.2 or 1.21.11.
changes: Click the version above Launch to choose between 26.2, 26.1.2 and 1.21.11
The same mods, resource packs, shader and settings on every version
Each version keeps its own worlds and screenshots; switching never touches the others
Your installation stays where it is, on 1.21.11
Mods with no build for the version you picked are named and skipped rather than blocking the launch
Game folders left behind by an old version are cleaned up on every start - worlds and screenshots are never removed

title: Two builds: Fight and Survival
description: The client is two clients now. Fight is the PvP build it has always been. Survival is a full world on Minecraft 26.1.2 with 141 mods and 59 resource packs, and you switch between them from the line above Launch.
changes: Pick your build from the line above Launch - it has an edit mark now, and opens a card for each one
Fight: Minecraft 1.21.11, the PvP mod set and packs, exactly as before
Survival: Minecraft 26.1.2, 141 mods, 59 resource packs and 8 shaders
Each build keeps its own mods, worlds, settings and screenshots - switching never touches the other one
Your existing installation becomes the Fight build, with everything where you left it
The Java version now comes from Minecraft's own manifest, so a build that needs a newer Java gets one
Fight's mods and packs are also in Survival, sitting under Survival's own; anything with no 26.1.2 build is listed but switched off

title: The PvP pack set, and Launch signs you in
description: The client now installs its own resource packs and shader and turns them on for you, and the big button signs you in when you are signed out instead of just saying so.
changes: Five PvP resource packs install themselves and are switched on in the right order: Classic Glint, Low Fire, Low Shield, Short Swords and Teeny Totem Pop
Complementary Reimagined is installed and selected as the shader, left switched off so it costs you nothing until you want it
Everything is pinned to an exact version and checked against its hash, so a pack cannot change under you between launches
New mod: G1axNameHistory, name history and UUIDs in chat
Default settings retuned: full field of view, render distance 8, hold to sprint, no view bob, no entity shadows
Signed out, the Launch button signs you in - the code to enter appears in the account panel

title: Discord presence and four ways in, closed
description: BestClient now shows on your Discord profile, and the launcher shuts the routes a cheat client uses to get into the game behind the mod check.
changes: Discord: your profile shows whether you are in the launcher or in game, which server you joined and how long you have played, with a switch in Settings that clears it the moment you turn it off
The JVM attach mechanism is closed, which is how an injector loads itself into a game that is already running
Startup flags that can load code - Java agents, boot class path, Fabric and Mixin loader properties - are refused, in the settings box and again at launch
The launch stops if another launcher has been pointed at the game folder, because starting from it would skip the mod check entirely
The application refuses to start if its own files were edited, and can no longer be re-run as plain Node to load an outside script

title: News pictures lose the dashed outline
description: The dashed white border added in the last build is gone. Hovering a news item still turns the cursor into a pointer and lifts the picture a little.
changes: News: the dashed white outline on hover was removed
The pointer cursor and the slight lift on hover stay

title: News pictures mark themselves
description: A news item you can open now says so: the cursor becomes a pointer and the picture picks up a dashed white outline while you are over it.
changes: News: hovering an item that opens a link turns the cursor into a pointer and outlines the picture with a dashed white border
The outline takes no space when it appears, so the picture never shifts under the cursor

title: Editable startup flags, calmer news hover
description: Settings now shows the complete JVM command line the game starts with and lets you edit all of it, and news pictures answer the cursor with a much smaller lift.
changes: Settings: a new Startup flags section listing every JVM flag the launcher uses, fully editable, with the heap line shown above it and a one-click restore to the defaults
Your edits are written when you leave the field instead of on every keystroke
News: the picture lifts far less on hover

title: Single deletion notice, news pictures grow on hover
description: Clearing the cache or the logs now confirms it exactly where you clicked instead of repeating the message in three sections, and news pictures truly become bigger when you hover instead of zooming into their crop.
changes: The cache and log deletion toasts are scoped to their own section - one place, once
News: on hover the whole picture grows larger, anchored upward; the crop inside the frame no longer magnifies

title: Remembered launch behaviour, glowing launch button, softer news hover
description: The launch behaviour is a real remembered choice again (Stay open is still the default), the BestClient mod shows the same switch as every other mod - pinned on and unflippable -, news pictures light up by growing on hover instead of darkening, and the launch button glows and grows a touch under the cursor.
changes: Launch behaviour: Stay open, Minimise launcher and Hide launcher are all back as a real choice, defaulting to Stay open; the launcher remembers what you picked even after a full close
BestClient mod: the same switch as every other mod, sitting in the on position - it just cannot be flipped, from the UI or from the main process
News: on hover the picture now grows a little inside its box; the card no longer darkens
Launch game button: a soft brand glow and a slight grow under the cursor

title: BestClient mod always on, stay-open launcher, static two-column news
description: The bundled mod is installed at startup and is always on with no way to switch it, the launcher only ever stays open after launching the game, the news section is a static two-column grid with bigger, never-zooming pictures, the GPU line is gone, and the RAM icon is bigger and grey.
changes: BestClient mod: installed as soon as the launcher starts and always on - the Mods list shows a fixed On pill instead of a switch, and the main process refuses to touch it
Launch behaviour: Stay open is the only option now, set as the default for everyone; the launcher remembers it from launch to launch
News: a static two-column grid at fixed 16:9 banners, pictures bigger; no zoom on hover, more items just continue below on the page scroll
The GPU model line was removed from the Play screen and Settings - no more telling you what video card you have
RAM icon: bigger and grey instead of the small rose chip

title: Fixed 16:9 window, Minecraft-font MOTDs, bundled in-game mod
description: The launcher is a fixed 1366x768 canvas now, partner-server MOTDs are drawn with Minecraft's own pixel font, the in-game BestClient mod ships inside the installer, and Settings gained dedicated, iconed Cache and Logs sections.
changes: The window is a fixed 1366x768 16:9 canvas - slightly bigger than before, not resizable and not maximizable, so every screen is built exactly for that size
Partner-server MOTDs render in Minecraft's own pixel font, bundled with the client: skulls, swords, hearts and stars look like in-game text instead of colourful Windows emojis
News: the grid is a static three columns and every banner lives in a fixed 16:9 box; hovering grows the picture inside its box without moving anything around it
Settings: Clear cache and Clear logs moved out of Maintenance into their own sections, each with its own icon
Update checks run twice as often (every 15 minutes) and the news/changelog feeds refresh every minute instead of every five
The BestClient mod is now bundled in the installer (SHA-1-stamped against tampering): Right Shift opens the in-game menu in Minecraft, starting with Fullbright
Closing the launcher while the game is running no longer disturbs it - the game keeps running on its own

title: BestClient mod, store, news and changelog feed, GPU detection fix
description: The client ships with its own in-game mod (fullbright, no hurt camera, a Right Shift menu), the launcher grows a store, a market, news and changelog rails, and the NVIDIA default is now decided from every adapter instead of just the first one.
changes: In-game mod: Fullbright toggle and brightness slider, hurt camera toggle and a client menu on Right Shift, settings saved in bestclient.json
Store and market views with the full catalog, so the client's own content has a home
News feed and changelog rail on the home screen, pulled straight from GitHub
Self-updater: version.json in the repo is the single source the launcher polls; downloads and verifies the installer by SHA-256
GPU detection: every adapter is checked now, so a hybrid laptop reports NVIDIA even when Chromium lists the integrated card first; an unknown GPU is never persisted as a wrong default
Maintenance actions in Settings to clear caches and logs
Server ping and inventory details on the game page, bundled mods stamped at install time
Release admin: version.json, changelog.json and news.json drive the whole flow

title: NVIDIA optimization switch, instant mod updates, GPU-aware defaults
description: A new Settings switch tailored to the detected GPU adds Nvidium and Reflex to the modpack on NVIDIA cards, and the Mods list can update any mod to its newest build in one click.
changes: Settings: NVIDIA optimization switch - adds Nvidium and Reflex Anti-Lag to the modpack; on by default on NVIDIA GPUs, off on AMD and Intel, decided from your actual hardware on first run; turning it off removes the mods again
Mods list: an Update chip appears left of the version button when a newer build exists, and clicking it swaps in the newest version instantly
News banners grow only when the cursor is on the picture itself, and the faint hairline on the left edge is gone
The delete button just tints red on hover instead of going solid red
The RAM slider knob is plain rose - no black ring, no shadow

title: Injection protection, borderless Launch button, chip RAM readout
description: The launcher checks the mods folder for known hacked clients and injectors before every launch, the Launch Game button lost its border, and the RAM readout shows a memory chip instead of "max".
changes: Before every launch the mods folder is checked against known hacked clients and injectors such as Doomsday, LiquidBounce and Aristois - by file name, and by scanning the bytes of Modrinth-approved jars, so a renamed injector cannot sneak in; anything flagged blocks the launch with its own warning
Launch Game has no border - just the clean rounded brand-coloured button
The RAM readout shows a memory-chip icon instead of "MAX"
Store sort menu items have a small gap between them
News banners zoom less on hover; "Double-click to join" is properly capitalised

title: Richer store cards, custom sort dropdown, opaque panels
description: Store cards now show the author, category tags and download/follower counts, the sort control is a custom rounded dropdown, and the popup panels are solid instead of translucent.
changes: Store cards show the author, up to three category tags, and download and follower counts with a heart
The store's result order is a custom rounded dropdown that matches the rest of the UI
Mods list: the version button is right-aligned and always shows the full version string
News banners alternate left and right in the two-column layout, and growing on hover no longer shifts the text below
Partner-server cards and the account-switcher popup have solid, opaque backgrounds

title: Bigger news banners, Stay-open default, build dropdown
description: News banners are larger and grow on hover instead of zooming, the launcher stays open by default when the game starts, and switching a mod's build is a dropdown next to the version button.
changes: News banners are bigger; on hover they grow instead of zooming, so the picture's edges are never clipped
Settings: new "Stay open" option, on by default - the launcher keeps its window when the game starts; Minimise launcher and Hide launcher remain
The build picker is now a dropdown attached to the version button, opening above or below it depending on the space
The on/off switches use a darker, stronger green

title: White button text, restored button colours, clean news banners
description: The buttons say their text in white over the familiar colours again, the build-picker popup works exactly as before, and the news banners are back to natural size without a dark backing box.
changes: Button text is white; button backgrounds are the 0.2.0 look (brand-pink Download and Browse files, grey Search, pager, Update)
The build-picker popup and its buttons work as in 0.2.0
News banners: no black backing box, natural size, bigger gap between items
Partner-server MOTDs rewrite Windows colour emojis to Minecraft-font symbols
Store, mod list and Settings keep the soft rounded panel behind the content

title: Minecraft-style MOTDs, white buttons and softer panels
description: Partner-server MOTDs speak in Minecraft's own symbols instead of Windows colour emojis, the store, the mod list and the settings sit on a rounded panel in front of the wallpaper, and every solid button is white now.
changes: Partner-server MOTDs: Windows colour emojis are rewritten to Minecraft's monochrome symbols
Modrinth, the mod list and Settings sit on one soft rounded panel, inset from the edges of the page
Solid buttons - Search, Download, Update, Browse files, pager, settings - are white instead of dark
News moved further down, banners shown at natural size without cropping or stretching
Hovering a news item zooms its banner slightly
The memory slider has a thicker, brand-pink knob

title: Partner servers, the changelog rail and in-game BestClient
description: The Play screen now shows live partner-server status you can join with a double-click, the mod list finally covers everything that is actually installed, and the client ships with its own in-game mod.
changes: Partner servers: live player count, MOTD and server icon, queried directly from the server
Double-click a partner server to launch straight onto it
Fixed the server lookup so a server published on an SRV record is reachable
New changelog rail down the right-hand side, on every screen
The mod list now shows pack mods, Modrinth installs and jars you added yourself, all in one place
Search your own mods, and switch any mod to a different Modrinth build
Modrinth store: sorting, twelve results per page, and a grid that never leaves a half-empty row
BestClient's own mod ships with the client and cannot be removed - Right Shift opens the in-game menu
The game console rises from the bottom the moment a launch starts
Automatic update check, with the install left to you
Hardened the launcher: strict content policy, allow-list sanitizer for remote content, and stricter file handling

title: First build
description: Microsoft sign-in, the Fabric 1.21.11 install pipeline, the Modrinth store and the PvP-tuned defaults.
changes: Microsoft device-code sign-in with multiple accounts
Fabric 1.21.11 install pipeline with automatic dependency resolution
Modrinth store for extra mods
PvP-tuned JVM flags and options.txt baseline
